note: (a) forbidden: an IPv6-capable IS omitting the IPv6 NLPID from TLV 129, or advertising a value other than 142 (0x8E). (b) circuit TestRFC5308HelloNLPIDIs142 checks the transmitted dual-stack IIH's TLV 129 wire octets equal exactly cc 8e, against the literal rather than packet.NLPIDIPv6, closing the constant gap; TestISISProtocolsSupportedDualStack and TestISISIIHTLV232LinkLocal cover the advertise clause and the IPv4-only cases (TestISISProtocolsSupportedDualStack ipv4-only, TestISISIIHNoTLV232WhenIPv4Only) the absence when IPv6 is not supported.
